title: Take-Two Interactive Form 10-K, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026
claim: Describes the September 2022 Rockstar intrusion, source-code protection, third-party access to proprietary information, a 2022 vendor help-desk compromise used to send players a malicious link, and 12,909 full-time employees (9,998 in product development).
plannedUse: Company-specific evidence for Build Theft, Insider Leak, and Fake Downloads; workforce size for control costs.

title: Grand Theft Auto 5 sales surpass $1 billion (Take-Two announcement)
claim: GTA V reached $800 million in its first 24 hours and more than $1 billion in three days.
plannedUse: Historical anchor for launch-window revenue concentration.

title: GTA VI pulls in estimated $1.84 billion by release day (Sensor Tower estimates)
claim: Sensor Tower estimated about $1.65 billion by noon Nov 18 and $1.84 billion (19.05 million units) by release day; PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only; $80 standard and $100 ultimate editions. Third-party estimate, not Take-Two data.
plannedUse: Derives hourly launch revenue at risk.

title: GTA 6 pre-orders point to record-breaking launch week (Newzoo analysis)
claim: Newzoo projected $3.3 billion to $5.2 billion in launch-week sales (central case about $4.5 billion, ~51 million units at $88 ASP).
plannedUse: Upper bound for launch-week revenue at risk.

title: PSN Back Online After Two Outages Around GTA 6 Launch
claim: PlayStation Network had service disruptions on Nov 18 and Nov 19, 2026 around the GTA VI launch; Sony gave no cause. Launch-week reporting found no widespread outage on Rockstar's own services.
plannedUse: Evidence of third-party platform dependency and baseline launch capacity.

title: Overwatch 2 launch derailed by major DDoS attack
claim: Blizzard's president confirmed a mass DDoS attack during the Overwatch 2 launch; a second DDoS followed and connection problems lasted more than a day.
plannedUse: Precedent for launch-day DDoS probability, success, and outage duration.

title: Cloudflare 2025 Q3 DDoS threat report, including Aisuru
claim: The Aisuru botnet-for-hire launched record hyper-volumetric attacks (29.7 Tbps) and targeted gaming companies among others; gaming and gambling ranked among the most-attacked industries.
plannedUse: Threat capability and targeting evidence for DDoS attack probability.

title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026
claim: 935 attacks above 1 Tbps in H1 2026; most DDoS attacks are short-lived; automated always-on protection is recommended.
plannedUse: Supports duration assumptions and the managed-protection control effect.

title: AWS Shield pricing
claim: Shield Advanced costs $3,000 per month per organization with a one-year commitment plus data-transfer usage fees.
plannedUse: Public price floor for managed DDoS protection; enterprise CDN contracts are team estimates.

title: The GTA 6 leak cost Rockstar $5 million and thousands of hours of staff time
claim: Rockstar told a UK court the 2022 intrusion cost about $5 million to recover from plus thousands of hours of staff time.
plannedUse: Anchor for Build Theft investigation, recovery, and staff-disruption costs.

title: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty over 90-video leak Rockstar says cost $5 million
claim: The Lapsus$ member behind the 2022 Rockstar intrusion pleaded guilty on Nov 16, 2026; 90 development clips were exposed and source code was threatened.
plannedUse: Confirms the attack path and extortion element for Build Theft.

title: Riot Games latest video-game maker to suffer breach
claim: Riot Games (2023), Electronic Arts (2021, Slack social engineering), and CD Projekt Red (2021) all had game source code stolen.
plannedUse: Peer base rate for Build Theft frequency.

title: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025 (press release)

plannedUse: Calibration range for breach-related loss magnitudes.

title: Survey sees global decline in data breach costs (IBM 2025 attack-vector costs)

title: The security risk organizations should not ignore: careless, negligent and malicious insiders

title: Rockstar says the employees it fired were leaking information

plannedUse: Context for Insider Leak; not used as proof of a leak.

title: Experts warn GTA and Minecraft being used to lure in cyberattack victims

title: Fake GTA 6 Extended Look and demo sites deliver an infostealer

title: PSN outage will cost Sony $171.1 million
